description: Check the payment status of a checkout session. Use this to poll for completion after sending the patient a payment link (the `payment_url` from checkout_create). When the patient pays via the link, this tool detects the payment, triggers order fulfillment, and returns the confirmation. Poll every 5-10 seconds while waiting. Requires authentication.

bearer_token.description: Authentication token for the patient session
bearer_token.title: Bearer Token

checkout_id.description: Checkout session ID to check payment status for
checkout_id.title: Checkout Id

name: checkout_status
title: Get Checkout Status
